svg.title: Cluster topology: three K3s VMs cloned from one template
svg.desc: Terraform reads the template name from packer-manifest.json and clones the Debian 13 template, VM 900, into three VMs inside the existing Proxmox resource pool k3s-csi: kube-master-01 (VM 200, 4 vCPU, 12 GB memory), kube-worker-01 (VM 201) and kube-worker-02 (VM 202), each worker with 6 vCPU and 24 GB memory. Every VM has a 96 GB disk and two network interfaces: one on bridge vmbr0, the management network 10.9.9.0/24, and one on bridge vmbr1, the services network 10.9.8.0/24, with host addresses .50, .51 and .52. Each worker also gets a GPU virtual function through the Proxmox PCI mapping k3s-worker-gpus. Each worker stores the control plane's SMBIOS UUID in force_recreate_on_change_of, so replacing the control plane recreates both workers.
svg.text: VM 900 · built by packer, cloned by name

g.text: cidrhost(base_cidr, start_offset + index), offset 50, workers after the control plane. Only vmbr1 has a gateway.
A replaced control plane gets a new UUID, so Terraform recreates both workers with it.
Proxmox CSI attaches them later; Terraform ignores disks[0].scsi.
